releaseNotes: v1.9.1-BETA: Three surgical regression fixes for beta testing. All categories now display correctly (numeric category names no longer dropped). DVR playback fully fixed — recordings now store permanent content:// URIs and open a fresh file descriptor at playback time so USB/OTG drives are readable. Custom DYLANDOS app icon now applied across all screen densities.
changelog: FIX: Live TV categories — numeric category names are no longer hidden (was filtering ALL categories on some servers)
FIX: DVR playback — permanent content:// URI now stored at recording start, not ephemeral /proc/self/fd path
FIX: DVR playback — fresh ParcelFileDescriptor opened via contentResolver at playback time (fd:// handoff to LibVLC)
FIX: DVR navigation — DvrScreen now routes to 'dvr' stream type so PlayerViewModel doesn't try to construct Xtream HTTP URL from a file path
NEW: Custom DYLANDOS brand icon applied to all mipmap densities (mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)
